title: GamerMode
description: Whatever you do... Don't step on grass....
body:
**_PLUGIN IS CURRENTLY IN HEAVY BETA!_**

# INFORMATION

This Spigot/Paper plugin makes true gamers come out! Never touched grass? You don't want to with this plugin! **Any file ending in `SPIGOT` is a spigot file, and any ending in `PAPER` is a paper file.**

## HOW IT WORKS

When this plugin is downloaded on your server, whenever you touch grass, you die!

## HOW TO INSTALL/DOWNLOAD

Make sure your server is on Paper or Spigot for 1.21.8-1.21.10. Download this plugin (latest version for best experience), navigate to your server files, open the plugins folder, upload the file into the folder, restart your server, and enjoy!

## BUG REPORT/SUPPORT

We have a Discord server for you to get help, report bugs, suggest mods, and suggest things to be added into mods. You can join it in the Discord icon on the sidebar on the right.
